newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials push higher again as bonds recover.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials push higher again as bonds recover.

text.p: U.S. blue-chip stocks, which earlier rose and fell in choppy trade, pushed higher for a second time on Wednesday as U.S. government bonds firmed.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up about 32 points to 7790 by midafternoon, as bonds moved off their lows. The long bond was down just 1/32 to yield 6.70 percent.
The Nasdaq Composite was up four points at 1456.
Stocks were also getting a boost from money managers buying shares to adjust their portfolios before the quarter closed, traders said.
